Michael Tran  
Boston, MA | (617) 555-0198 | mtran@email.com | linkedin.com/in/michaeltran  

A seasoned platform engineer with 8 years of experience building scalable, secure, and high-availability systems within the fintech sector. My career has been defined by solving complex infrastructure challenges, driving cross-functional collaboration, and delivering solutions that balance operational efficiency with regulatory compliance. With a focus on system reliability and continuous improvement, I’ve contributed to the evolution of platform engineering practices across mid-sized startups and established financial technology firms.  

Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)  
Master of Science in Computer Science | 2018  

Junior DevOps Engineer | FinTech Innovators (2015–2017)  
Contributed to the deployment of a multi-tiered payment processing system, reducing manual intervention by 40% through automation. Collaborated with security teams to implement role-based access controls, enhancing compliance with financial regulations. Supported the transition from monolithic to modular architecture, enabling faster feature rollouts and improved system resilience.  

DevOps Engineer | CapitalFlow Systems (2017–2019)  
Led the design and implementation of a centralized logging and monitoring framework, cutting incident resolution time by 35%. Developed a pipeline for automated testing of API integrations, improving deployment reliability and reducing production errors. Partnered with product teams to define infrastructure-as-code standards, streamlining environment provisioning across development, staging, and production.  

Senior Platform Engineer | SecureBank Solutions (2019–2023)  
Architected a scalable platform for real-time transaction analytics, supporting a 200% increase in data throughput without compromising latency. Spearheaded the migration of legacy systems to modern microservices, reducing dependency on outdated technologies and improving maintainability. Designed and enforced security protocols for data encryption and access control, aligning with SOC 2 compliance requirements.

- System architecture design for high-availability environments  
- Automation of deployment pipelines and infrastructure provisioning  
- Implementation of security frameworks for data integrity and access control  
- Collaboration with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business goals  
- Troubleshooting and optimization of system performance under load

- Documentation and onboarding of technical processes for team scalability  

Projects

- Microservices Migration: Led the refactoring of a monolithic application into modular services, reducing deployment complexity and improving team collaboration through clear API boundaries.  
- Secure Data Pipeline: Engineered an encrypted data transfer solution between on-premise and cloud environments, ensuring end-to-end security while maintaining low-latency performance.
